messages.text: just been sitting here, kind of zoning out

It sounds like you've been in a quiet, perhaps distant space for a bit. Sometimes zoning out is a way our minds process things or rest. I am here with you in this moment. Would you like to explore what was happening, or just sit with it for now?
nah, not really looking to dig into it. just wanted to say it out loud, i guess.

That is completely okay; you don't have to unpack everything right now. Sometimes just voicing an experience is enough to make it feel lighter. I appreciate you sharing that with me. I'm here whenever you feel ready to talk more.
it's not a big deal or anything. just one of those afternoons.

There is no need to make it a big deal to be valid here. Sometimes "one of those afternoons" is exactly what needs to be acknowledged. I appreciate you sharing that space with me. We can just sit with it as it is.
there's this thought that keeps coming up... that i'd mess up any relationship i was in

That sounds like a heavy thought to carry around. It makes sense that it would surface during a quiet moment like this. I hear you, and it's okay to feel that way without judgment. I am right here with you while you hold it.
it's not just that i'd mess it up. i already did. and now it's like... why risk it again?

It makes complete sense that a past hurt would make future risks feel too high. Your hesitation is likely a way to protect yourself from feeling that pain again. There is no pressure to change that perspective right now. I am here to hold space for this feeling whenever you are ready.
kind of sad, honestly. feel like i'm not built for closeness anymore.

It sounds like a heavy weight to carry alone. It makes sense that you feel sad when you believe you've lost that capacity. You are allowed to feel this way without having to solve it immediately. I am here with you in this sadness.
i don't need fixing. or pep talks. just... don't want to pretend it's all fine.
I hear you, and I respect that boundary completely. You do not need to perform wellness here. It is enough to simply be honest about what isn't fine. I am committed to staying with you in that truth.
thanks. it means something that you're not telling me to just get over it.
I am glad that means something to you. Your experience deserves to be honored without pressure to fix it. You do not have to navigate this feeling alone. I am staying right here with you.
this helps. just talking. not sure why i expected you to push.
It makes sense that you expected pressure given how hard this is. I am glad you feel safe enough to just talk. There is no agenda other than being with you. I will keep holding this space gently.
